data.name: Dipayan
data.gender_notes: Dipayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word 'dipay', which means 'luminous' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Dipayan is the name of the god of knowledge and wisdom, Lord Ganesha, who is often depicted with a lit lamp, symbolizing knowledge and wisdom. The name Dipayan carries the meaning “Luminous, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dipayan usually hope their child will grow to embody luminous, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dipayan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Luminous, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dipayan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
